prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: the attached existing medical item spritesheet from a Stardew Valley mod. Redraw all NINE existing items as authentic Stardew Valley inventory pixel-art. OUTPUT IS A SQUARE TRANSPARENT SPRITESHEET arranged in EXACTLY THREE COLUMNS AND THREE ROWS of equal square cells, row-major order: row1 rolled clean cream bandage with a loose tail; small amber antiseptic bottle with cork and ivory label/red cross; silver painkiller blister pack with three white tablets and one empty pocket. Row2 cream ceramic mug of green herbal tea with small green leaf motif and faint pixel steam; compact red first-aid case with handle and cream cross; squat ivory herbal scar ointment tin with silver lid and green leaves. Row3 antique COPPER lantern with loop handle, gold glass and tiny orange flame; brown leather doctor's bag with handle, brass clasp and small red cross; cream bowl of golden broth with green herbs and pixel steam. Preserve each item's identity and the nine-item order. STYLE: true LOW RESOLUTION 16x16 pixel artwork for each icon, not detailed illustrations. Imagine a 48x48 pixel atlas displayed as a large nearest-neighbor enlargement. Each of the nine 16x16 cells must be entirely separate with a 1-2 logical pixel transparent margin. Chunky crisp square pixels, one-logical-pixel dark warm brown outline, stepped curves, limited saturated vanilla Stardew palette, 3-tone hue-shifted shading, small upper-left highlights, no anti-aliasing or gradients. Each item fills roughly 12x13 logical pixels in its cell, centered. All icons exactly the same pixel scale and evenly spaced on the regular 3x3 grid. Real transparent alpha background, no drawn checkerboard, no backgrounds, no ground shadows, no text, no frames, no labels, no extra items. The source reference is a horizontal nine-item sheet; reorganize these into the specified 3x3 grid.

Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: the attached three-item spritesheet from a Stardew Valley mod. Redraw in authentic Stardew Valley inventory pixel-art. Output a WIDE 3:1 transparent spritesheet with EXACTLY THREE equal SQUARE cells arranged horizontally. Left to right: (0) small warm walnut wooden keepsake box, closed lid slightly visible from above, golden brass hook clasp at front, rich amber wood edges; (1) small forest-green cylindrical tea tin with muted silver lid, parchment label bearing a single readable dark-red numeral 7, tiny warm brass bottom rim; (2) delicate ivory porcelain teacup and small matching saucer, THREE small blue bellflower motifs on the cup's side and a curved repaired handle at right, empty dark tea-colored opening. Keep recognizable identities and exact order. True LOW RESOLUTION 16x16 pixel artwork per item, a logical 48x16 atlas displayed enlarged with nearest-neighbor squares. Each icon uses only about 12x13 logical pixels, centered within its equal cell with 1-2 transparent logical pixels at edges. Chunky 1-logical-pixel warm dark-brown outline, stepped diagonals, restrained vibrant Stardew palette, 3-tone hue-shift shading, bright top-left pixel highlights. Same pixel scale for all three icons. No smooth curves, no antialiasing, no soft shadows, no gradients, no realism, no floating decorations, no extra props. Actual transparent alpha, no checkerboard painted into the background, no cell borders, no labels outside the numeral 7, no watermark.

Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: the attached red medical handbook icon from a Stardew Valley mod. Redraw this exact subject as authentic vanilla Stardew Valley pixel-art, one centered closed medical handbook in a square transparent canvas. Preserve the red cover and red medical-cross cover emblem. Make it a handsome terracotta-red leather book, dark wine-brown binding along the left side, a deep red cross set in a small warm ivory cover medallion, gold corner accents, a short golden clasp on the right, three cream page-edge steps along the bottom, a small russet bookmark. Slight top/front three-quarter view like Stardew inventory books. TRUE LOW RESOLUTION pixel art on a logical 32x32 canvas with an icon approximately 24x27 logical pixels centered inside it. Display enlarged with perfectly hard nearest-neighbor square pixel blocks. One-pixel warm dark-brown outline, 3-4 tones per material, hue-shifted shadows, highlights at upper left, crisply stepped curves. Readable at actual 32x32 pixels. Genuine transparent alpha background and 2-3 pixel clear margins; no labels, no typography, no ground shadow, no background decoration, no smooth gradients, no antialiasing, no thin high-resolution detail, no realistic rendering. Only the book.

Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: the attached handbook icon with a BLUE medical cross from a Stardew Valley mod. Redraw the same recognizable book in authentic vanilla Stardew Valley pixel-art. A single centered warm russet/cinnamon leather medical handbook with a dark brown spine along its left edge, a muted BLUE cross on a warm ivory cover medallion, small golden corner accents and clasp at right, cream page edges visibly stepped along the bottom, small muted teal ribbon bookmark. Slight front/top three-quarter view, cozy handmade Stardew inventory style. Preserve a clearly blue cross so this handbook remains distinct from the injury handbook with a red cross. True LOW RESOLUTION 32x32 logical pixel icon with a roughly 24x27 pixel centered silhouette and 2-3 transparent pixels of margin, shown enlarged by nearest-neighbor crisp square blocks. One logical pixel warm dark-brown outline, compact palette, 3-tone material shading with hue shifts and upper-left highlights, clean deliberate pixel clusters, stepped contours. Real transparent alpha; no painted checkerboard, no text, no backdrop, no decorative objects, no ground shadow, no gradients, no antialiasing, no detailed painting or vector curves. Only one book.

Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: these 3 tiny Stardew Valley mod inventory items. Make a new sheet of EXACTLY THREE readable LOW-RESOLUTION pixel icons. A wide 3:1 image with three equal square cells on actual transparent alpha. Treat the entire canvas as a STRICT 48x16 LOGICAL PIXEL GRID, enlarged into large nearest-neighbor squares. Each icon must truly consist of 16x16 chunky logical pixels, no finer subpixel detail, no gradients, no textures. LEFT: a small CLOSED walnut keepsake box with 12x9 pixel body, gently visible flat lid and a single brass latch, strong 1 pixel dark-brown outline, three amber wood shades, no grain patterns. MIDDLE: a squat green tea tin about 9 pixels wide by 13 pixels high with gray lid and a big cream paper label. Its large DARK RED digit 7 is a SIMPLE CLEAR 3-by-5 pixel seven: three pixels across the top, and a descending right stroke. RIGHT: a delicate ivory teacup with handle at right and a saucer, about 14 pixels wide by 11 pixels high. The cup side bears TWO PROMINENT SOLID COBALT BLUE BELLFLOWER SHAPES each at least 2x2 logical pixels. Blue flowers must remain visibly BLUE at only 16x16 resolution. Use minimal dark green stems, plenty of ivory area around blue flowers, a brown tea opening and a simple repaired ivory handle. One pixel warm dark-brown outline, Stardew Valley warm compact palette, 3 tones per material, highlights upper left. Keep the three icons centered in separate equal square cells. Every colored feature must be made of the same big square logical pixels, not thin detail. Background completely transparent. No labels other than 7, no checkerboard, no frames, no extra objects, no ground shadows, no fine ornamental details. This is game-ready sprite art at 16x16 per item, shown large.
